learning_objective.zh: 看四种基本情绪(开心/难过/生气/害怕)的表情图,孩子能正确命名至少 3 种;并在日常情境中提示下用情绪词说出自己当下的心情(连续 2 次达成)。

intro.zh: 每个人都有心情。我的心情有名字:开心、难过、生气、害怕。看看一张脸,或者想想我自己,我就能说出这是什么心情。
intro.en: Everyone has feelings. My feelings have names: happy, sad, angry, and scared. When I look at a face or notice myself, I can name the feeling.

review.zh: 我学会了给心情起名字:开心、难过、生气、害怕。看看一张脸,或者想想我自己,我就能说出现在的心情。说出来以后,大人更懂我,我也更舒服。
review.en: I learned to name my feelings: happy, sad, angry, and scared. When I look at a face or notice myself, I can name the feeling. When I name it, grown-ups understand me and I feel better.

text.zh: 嘴角弯弯往上翘,这是开心。
text.en: When the mouth curves up, that is happy.

narration.zh: 嘴角弯弯地往上翘,眼睛亮亮的,这是开心。
narration.en: When the mouth curves up and the eyes are bright, that feeling is happy.

text.zh: 嘴角往下,眼睛低低的,这是难过。
text.en: When the mouth turns down, that is sad.

narration.zh: 嘴角往下,眼睛看着下面,这是难过。
narration.en: When the mouth turns down and the eyes look low, that feeling is sad.

text.en: When the eyebrows scrunch, that is angry.

narration.zh: 眉毛皱皱地往中间靠,这是生气。
narration.en: When the eyebrows scrunch together, that feeling is angry.

text.zh: 眼睛睁得大大的,这是害怕。
text.en: When the eyes open wide, that is scared.

narration.zh: 眼睛睁得大大的,身体缩一缩,这是害怕。
narration.en: When the eyes open wide, that feeling is scared.

prompt.zh: 看这张脸,嘴角弯弯往上翘。轮到你,这是什么心情?
prompt.en: Look at this face with the mouth curved up. Your turn — what feeling is this?

prompt.zh: 这张脸嘴角往下、眼睛低低的。轮到你,这是什么心情?
prompt.en: This face has a downturned mouth and low eyes. Your turn — what feeling is this?

prompt.zh: 现在换你自己。你现在的心情是什么?可以用一个词说出来。
prompt.en: Now it is about you. What is your feeling right now? You can name it with one word.

answer.en: Right now I feel a little happy.

reinforce.zh: 你说出了自己的心情,很了不起。
reinforce.en: You named your own feeling. Wonderful.

scenario.zh: 你的玩具被朋友不小心碰坏了,你心里有点难过……你可以怎么做?
scenario.en: A friend accidentally broke your toy and you feel a little sad... what can you do?

outcome.zh: 你让大人知道你有点难过,大人明白了,过来陪你、一起想办法。
outcome.en: You let a grown-up know you feel sad, they understand and come to help you.

outcome.zh: 你指着难过的情绪卡,大人一下就明白了,过来轻轻抱抱你。
outcome.en: You point to the sad card, a grown-up understands right away and gives you a gentle hug.

caption.zh: 开心 😊 · 难过 😢 · 生气 😠 · 害怕 😨
我现在觉得……开心 / 难过 / 生气 / 害怕。
caption.en: Right now I feel... happy / sad / angry / scared.

caption.zh: 看嘴巴、看眼睛、看眉毛,再说出名字。
caption.en: Look at the mouth, eyes, and eyebrows, then name it.

title.en: Three steps to name a feeling

caption.zh: 停一停 → 看脸或想想自己 → 说出名字。
caption.en: Stop, look or notice, then name it.
